intro.text: Deadly wasps that nest inside trees and, unlike most creatures of the Pantheon, live only on the island of Patji.

description.text: They come and go from the nest through small holes in the bark, and trappers watch for wasp paper as a sign of one. A trapper who finds a nest pushes a stick into the hole so no wasp can get out; after that, only the workers already outside are a danger.
Their sting is extremely deadly, and the wasp dies as soon as it has stung. They lay their eggs in the bodies of their victims, and may also steal kills from other predators nearby, such as memist.
